title: Digital-twin G-code dry-run engine (third consensus checkpoint for MS9)
brief: Build prism_cam:cnc_simulate_predictive as a real engine that runs full RTCP envelope check + collision sim + reach margin on G-code BEFORE it leaves the gate. Closes Gemini's third consensus checkpoint and architect Gap #2 (no engine owns sim). Must cover ISO-EIA + Heidenhain conversational + Hurco NCL + EDM .ISO dialects.

phases.title: Build digital-twin sim engine + dialect adapters

units.title: Add cnc_simulate_predictive action to prism_cam dispatcher
exit_conditions: Zod schema validates {gcode, machineId, dialect, fixtureModel, toolModel}
tests: 3 happy + 3 failure (unsupported dialect, missing fixture, malformed gcode)
units.description: New dispatcher action surface. Lazy-import sim engine.

units.title: Implement DigitalTwinSimulationEngine with RTCP envelope + collision
exit_conditions: RTCP-resolved envelope check finds 5/5 staged collisions (carriage-vs-fixture, tool-vs-clamp, RTCP-flip, axis-reach, work-volume-exit)
reach margin computed per axis, fail if <5mm
outputs structured collision[] with {type, axisCoord, severity}
units.description: Core engine. Use existing CollisionPreventionEngine + reach-envelope helpers if present; only build what's missing. Must reuse, not duplicate.

units.title: Dialect adapters: ISO-EIA, Heidenhain, Hurco NCL, EDM .ISO
exit_conditions: each of 4 dialects parses 1 reference program from JM DIE/
round-trip: dialect -> canonical -> dialect produces byte-identical output
units.description: Adapter chain. Heidenhain conversational has no G-codes; EDM .ISO is wire/sinker variants. Reference programs from JM DIE/ archive.

units.title: Wire as MS9 third consensus checkpoint + ledger
exit_conditions: MS9 SafetyOmegaGate calls cnc_simulate_predictive as 3rd checkpoint
5 known-bad programs: BLOCKED with named cause
units.description: Integration with MS9. End-to-end pass on real JM Die programs. Block on any failure.

acceptance: prism_cam:cnc_simulate_predictive live; collision count = 0 on 20 reference programs; correctly flags 5 known-bad programs (>=2 must be 5-axis singularities); 4 dialects round-trip clean; wired into MS9 as 3rd checkpoint; ledger persists.

risks.description: Heidenhain conversational lacks formal grammar; mitigation = use existing HeidenhainPostEngine parser if present, else best-effort recognizer with explicit unsupported-form list
Full kinematic simulator is a 6-month project on its own; mitigation = swept-volume check + reach margin first, defer dynamics (jerk, accel) to post-pilot
Reusing CollisionPreventionEngine may leak state between simulations; mitigation = construct fresh per call, no module-level mutable state
